page.title: Quickstart · tinyactors
page.description: Install tinyactors in Node.js, Python, a browser or C, and run an order actor that retries its payment on its own, in five minutes.

hero.headline: Run your first actor in five minutes
hero.lede: Install one package and run one program. An order actor fills its cart, charges the card and retries on its own when the payment service is down.

section.heading: Write a chart and run it
section.p: The packages need Node.js 22.3 or Bun, Python 3.13 or newer, or a C compiler. Save the chart as order.scxml and the program beside it, then run the program; the tabs follow the package you picked above.
The first charge fails, so the chart waits a second and charges again. Your program never wrote that retry: it lives in the chart's retrying state.
Every package prints these same lines. The chart's expressions are JavaScript in every package, Python's included.

section.heading: The chart decides, your program acts

item.text: runs the actors inside your process, so there is no server to start. Its system id, shop, names it in actors' addresses, such as tinyactors://shop/@order-17.
holds every state the order can be in and the events that move it. Press the buttons under the diagram to drive it yourself.

is the payments object your program gives the host. The chart sends it charge and never calls a network itself, so a test can answer instead of a real service. Testing your charts fails the service three times and steps the clock past each wait, with no sleeping.
stops the actors in the process, the order waiting for its retry included. Journal and replay and snapshots bring them back.

section.heading: Let your coding agent read the docs
section.p: Add the tinyactors support server to your agent, and it can search these docs, load the skill for building with tinyactors and report what got in its way. In Claude Code:
section.code: claude mcp add --transport http tinyactors-support https://mcp.tinyactors.dev/mcp
section.p: Build with a coding agent covers the other agents and what the server offers.
